headline: Diesel and Kerosene Prices Drop by Nearly ₱4 per Liter as September Begins
seoTitle: Fuel Price Rollback September 1, 2026 | FMB News
seoDescription: Oil firms cut diesel and kerosene by nearly ₱4 per liter and gasoline by up to ₱0.40 per liter effective September 1.
deck: The September 1 rollback provided motorists relief after two consecutive weeks of fuel-price increases.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Fuel retailers implemented price cuts effective 6 a.m. on September 1, with the largest reductions applied to diesel and kerosene.

Seaoil announced cuts of ₱0.32 per liter for gasoline, ₱3.83 for diesel and ₱3.84 for kerosene, while Petron and Shell cut gasoline by ₱0.30 and diesel and kerosene by ₱3.80. Unioil announced gasoline and diesel reductions of ₱0.40 and ₱3.90, respectively.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The rollback followed two straight weeks of increases and reflected easing international oil-market pressure even as geopolitical risks remained.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Fuel-price movements affect household transport costs, logistics expenses and inflation-sensitive goods and services.

sections.heading: Correction to the brief
paragraphs: The original newsroom brief described a rollback of up to ₱1.00 per liter. Independently verified retailer advisories showed much larger diesel and kerosene cuts, reaching about ₱3.90 per liter.
